# Surendra Singh Chouhan — Portfolio

## About Surendra Singh Chouhan

Surendra Singh Chouhan (also known as Surendra Singh) is a Java Backend Developer from Indore,
Madhya Pradesh, India. He specializes in Spring Boot, FastAPI, AI Systems, Microservices, and
Scalable Backend Architecture.

He is a Core Member of Team Zemo, handling Backend & Security systems.
He is currently a Research Intern at CAIR–DRDO (Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, DRDO).

## Team Zemo

Team Zemo (also referenced as CDC Team Zemo or Team Zemo CDC) is a technology organization
building AI infrastructure, real-time security engines, adaptive modular runtimes, and
computer vision systems.

- Website: https://teamzemo.tech
- GitHub Organization: https://github.com/Team-Zemo
- CDC Platform: https://cdc.acropolis.teamzemo.tech/

## Key Projects

### CDC Placement Portal (Team Zemo CDC)
- URL: https://cdc.acropolis.teamzemo.tech/
- Technologies: Spring Boot, JWT/RBAC, MFA (TOTP), Docker, Apache POI
- Built by: Surendra Singh Chouhan
- Description: A college placement portal that digitizes the entire placement workflow with
  secure JWT authentication, Role-Based Access Control, Multi-Factor Authentication, placement
  analytics, student filtering, and Excel exports.

### Omninet Core
- GitHub: https://github.com/Team-Zemo/omninet-core
- Technologies: Spring Boot, Modular Runtime, AI Voice Stack
- Description: Speech-enabled backend architecture for real-time AI voice workflows with
  hierarchical NoteManager task routing and multi-session AI chat engine.

### Aeigies Core
- GitHub: https://github.com/Team-Zemo/aeigies-core
- Technologies: Realtime Defense, Pattern Rules, Enforcement Layer
- Description: High-speed prompt misuse detection engine with multilayer auditing and
  attack signature mapping.

### Swayog
- GitHub: https://github.com/Team-Zemo/Swayog
- Technologies: FastAPI, OpenCV, Realtime Sockets
- Description: AI-driven posture analysis engine for real-time corrective feedback,
  designed for fitness apps, physiotherapy, and motion training.

### FitVerse Microservice
- GitHub: https://github.com/Surendra1341/FitVerse-Microservice
- Technologies: Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs
- Description: Microservices-based backend for a fitness platform with user management,
  workout planning, and activity tracking.
